description: Implement auth module in NestJS (Task 6.1): register/login/refresh/logout/me endpoints with argon2id password hashing, JWT access tokens (15 min), opaque refresh tokens in Redis (30 days, rotated), rate-limit middleware, and JWT guard.
steps: Add dependencies to apps/api/package.json: argon2 (for argon2id hashing), @nestjs/jwt, @nestjs/passport, passport, passport-jwt, ioredis, uuid, @types/passport-jwt (dev), @types/uuid (dev)
Create apps/api/src/auth/auth.module.ts importing JwtModule (async config from env: secret, signOptions expiresIn '15m'), RedisModule, PrismaModule

Create apps/api/src/auth/auth.service.ts with methods: register(email, password, displayName), login(email, password), refresh(refreshToken), logout(refreshToken), getMe(userId). Password hashing uses argon2id with memoryCost=65536 (64MB), timeCost=3, parallelism=1. Refresh tokens are opaque UUIDs stored in Redis with 30-day TTL, rotated on each refresh call (old token deleted, new one issued).
Create apps/api/src/auth/auth.controller.ts with routes: POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login, POST /auth/refresh, POST /auth/logout, GET /auth/me (protected by JWT guard)

Create apps/api/src/auth/dto/ with register.dto.ts (email, password, displayName Zod schemas), login.dto.ts (email, password), refresh.dto.ts (refreshToken), and response types (tokens response with accessToken + refreshToken + expiresIn, user response)
Create apps/api/src/auth/guards/jwt.guard.ts implementing CanActivate that verifies JWT from Authorization Bearer header, extracts userId and role, attaches to request
Create apps/api/src/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts implementing passport JWT strategy for NestJS
Create apps/api/src/auth/middleware/rate-limit.middleware.ts implementing NestMiddleware with Redis token-bucket: max 5 attempts per IP+email combo in 15 minutes for /auth/login
Create apps/api/src/redis/redis.module.ts and redis.service.ts wrapping ioredis client with connection from REDIS_URL env
Wire the auth module into app.module.ts, configure rate-limit middleware for auth routes
Run pnpm install, then pnpm run typecheck and pnpm run lint to verify
acceptance_criteria: POST /auth/register creates a user with argon2id hashed password and returns tokens
POST /auth/login validates credentials and returns JWT access + opaque refresh token
POST /auth/refresh validates and rotates refresh token, returns new token pair
POST /auth/logout deletes refresh token from Redis
GET /auth/me requires valid JWT and returns user info
JWT expires in 15 minutes, refresh token in 30 days
Rate-limit middleware blocks after 5 failed login attempts per IP+email in 15 min
findings: Used @Inject(ServiceClass) pattern for all DI constructor parameters to satisfy consistent-type-imports ESLint rule while maintaining emitDecoratorMetadata compatibility. The RedisService extends ioredis Redis class directly. pnpm-lock.yaml updated with new deps: @nestjs/jwt, @nestjs/passport, passport, passport-jwt, uuid, @types/passport-jwt, @types/uuid.
